package rulefixtures

// scenario for nested_linear_join_map_candidate: Nested-loop lookups or joins that could use a map index for O(1) access.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.
type Product struct {
	ID    int
	Name  string
	Price float64
}

type OrderLine struct {
	ProductID int
	Quantity  int
}

func scenario358Positive(products []Product, lines []OrderLine) []string {
	var result []string
	for _, line := range lines {
		for _, p := range products {
			if p.ID == line.ProductID {
				result = append(result, p.Name)
			}
		}
	}
	return result
}
